study: Gauge and RoPE commutant: independent functional dimensions of Q/K attention
scope: EXPLORATORY ALGEBRA/FUNCTION-JACOBIAN audit; no natural tasks, no storage/latency benefit claim
h: For generic full-column-rank 4x2 Q and K matrices, the Jacobian of the bare score operator C0=Q K^T has rank12 and nullity4; augmenting with a nondegenerate RoPE-rotated score C1=Q R K^T gives rank14 and nullity2. Pure gauge directions never count as new logical functions. This is only a local linearized audit.

data.generation: torch.randn seeded double matrices; reject near-singular Q/K only on dev if necessary
data.probe: all 16 output entries per C0 and C1, not a subset

transform.G: GL(2) random invertible and 2x2 basis directions
transform.allowed_RoPE: G=aI+bJ with J=[[0,-1],[1,0]], commute with R(theta)

implementation.svd_recovery: finite difference parameter-to-score Jacobian size16x16 (no RoPE) and 32x16 (with RoPE)
implementation.conditioning: record cond2(Q),cond2(K), smallest nonzero SV and largest discarded SV

baselines: no RoPE gauge full GL2 tangent dimension4
invalid shear full pre-RoPE symmetry but not RoPE

gates.PASS: all 5 fresh worlds satisfy Jacobian rank 12 and 14 at frozen threshold, all noRoPE four Lie tangents score-error norm <=1e-10, two commuting RoPE tangents <=1e-10, noncommuting RoPE tangents have norm>=1e-3; exact finite GL gauge outputs agree within 1e-10 for C0
gates.FAIL: any pure symmetry counted as new functional state, or correct commuting and invalid noncommuting classes not distinguished, or fresh rank outside thresholds
gates.UNCERTAIN: Q/K ill-conditioned, singular value gap ambiguous, insufficient numerical precision, or reference gauges apply to network variants not actually tested

sequential_stop: No early stopping; fixed five fresh seeds after 3 development; fresh never tunes h or rank threshold

uncertainty.conditioning: float64 finite difference truncation/roundoff; compare analytic tangent checks
uncertainty.u_c: if combining independent uncertainties of a dimensionless observable, sqrt(u_seed^2+u_probe^2+u_num^2); otherwise include covariance
